r502Correlation.classification: Inherited R502 test synchronization defect. Not an integrated product transport failure.
r502Correlation.beforeFix: Focused and first full run saw child cleanup before asynchronous response-complete IPC; no product deadline expired. Selected case alone passed on both candidate and authoritative source; authoritative full 15-case file reproduced the same missing phase.
r502Correlation.fix: Await child cleanup AND response-complete with the existing vi.waitFor budget. All original phase, privacy, capacity, and exact-once assertions retained; no timeout increase.

experimentRetirement.classification: Task validation environment contamination; not product regression or baseline host timing.
experimentRetirement.cause: A temporary package.json with type=module placed in the first TMPDIR for a TS audit helper changed the module mode of the fixture extensionless CommonJS git stub. Node reported require is not defined in ES module scope.
experimentRetirement.baseline: Exact unchanged f710974 selected fixture passed in its separate clean TMPDIR.
experimentRetirement.correction: Removed only the task-owned helper package.json; renamed helper to .mts. Candidate selected fixture then passed, followed by all 20 retirement cases in final focused run. Final full rerun uses a fresh TMPDIR without ancestor package.json.
